product.olivetti-m480-10.summary: The AT-bus M480 with a 20 MHz 486SX and IDE or SCSI options.
product.olivetti-m480-10.history: The Olivetti service guide documents M480-10 (the AT-bus M480 with a 20 MHz 486SX and IDE or SCSI options).
product.olivetti-m480-10.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA372 · 82C453 · IDE / SCSI.
product.olivetti-m480-10.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.03 / 2.07 (BA372).
product.olivetti-m480-10.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m480-10.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m480-10.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 34-1.
